1: // Cosmic Dodger game with enhanced graphics targeting <canvas id="game">
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
5: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
6: 
7: // Ship
8: const ship = {x: 100, y: canvas.height/2, w: 30, h: 20, speed: 4};
9: const keys = {};
10: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
11: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
12: 
13: // Audio assets (use royalty‑free URLs)
14: const bgMusic = new Audio('https://assets.codepen.io/6093400/space-ambient.mp3');
15: bgMusic.loop = true;
16: bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
17: const thrustSound = new Audio('https://assets.codepen.io/6093400/thrust.wav');
18: thrustSound.volume = 0.2;
19: const crashSound = new Audio('https://assets.codepen.io/6093400/crash.wav');
20: crashSound.volume = 0.5;
21: let audioStarted = false;
22: // Debris
23: const debris = [];
24: let debrisTimer = 0;
25: const spawnDebris = () => {
26:   const size = Math.random()*30+10;
27:   const side = Math.random()<0.5?'left':'right';
28:   const y = Math.random()*canvas.height;
29:   const x = side==='left' ? -size : canvas.width+size;
30:   const vx = side==='left' ? (2+Math.random()*3) : -(2+Math.random()*3);
31:   const vy = (Math.random()-0.5)*2;
32:   debris.push({x, y, w:size, h:size, vx, vy});
33: };
34: 
35: // Starfield background with twinkling effect
36: const stars = [];
37: for(let i=0;i<120;i++){
38:   const baseR = Math.random()*1.5 + 0.5; // base radius
39:   stars.push({
40:     x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
41:     y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
42:     baseR: baseR,
43:     r: baseR, // current radius (updated each frame)
44:     speed: 0.3 + Math.random()*0.4,
45:     phase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
46:     flickerSpeed: 0.02 + Math.random()*0.03
47:   });
48: }
49: 
50: let distance = 0;
51: let gameOver = false;
52: 
53: function update(){
54:   // move ship
55:   let moving = false;
56:   if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']){ ship.y -= ship.speed; moving = true; }
57:   if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s']){ ship.y += ship.speed; moving = true; }
58:   if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a']){ ship.x -= ship.speed; moving = true; }
59:   if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d']){ ship.x += ship.speed; moving = true; }
60:   // keep within bounds
61:   ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.w, ship.x));
62:   ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height-ship.h, ship.y));
63: 
64:   // start audio on first interaction
65:   if(moving && !audioStarted){ bgMusic.play(); audioStarted = true; }
66:   // play thrust sound while moving
67:   if(moving){ thrustSound.currentTime = 0; thrustSound.play(); }
68: 
69:   // stars move left and twinkle
70:   stars.forEach(s=>{
71:     s.x -= s.speed; if(s.x<0) s.x = canvas.width;
72:     // twinkling effect using sinusoidal variation
73:     s.phase += s.flickerSpeed;
74:     s.r = s.baseR + Math.sin(s.phase) * s.baseR * 0.3;
75:   });
76: 
77:   // spawn debris every 60 frames (~1s at 60fps)
78:   if(debrisTimer-- <= 0){
79:     spawnDebris();
80:     debrisTimer = 60;
81:   }
82: 
83:   // update debris
84:   for(let i=debris.length-1;i>=0;i--){
85:     const d = debris[i];
86:     d.x += d.vx; d.y += d.vy;
87:     // remove when offscreen
88:     if(d.x < -d.w || d.x > canvas.width+ d.w) debris.splice(i,1);
89:     // collision
90:     if(!(ship.x + ship.w < d.x || ship.x > d.x + d.w || ship.y + ship.h < d.y || ship.y > d.y + d.h)){
91:       gameOver = true;
92:       crashSound.play();
93:     }
94:   }
95: 
96:   distance += 0.1; // arbitrary distance unit per frame
97: }
98: 
99: function draw(){
100:   // draw background gradient
101:   ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
102:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
103:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0,'#001');
104:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1,'#000');
105:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
106:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
107: 
108:   // stars with subtle glow
109:   ctx.save();
110:   ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
111:   ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
112:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
113:   stars.forEach(s=>{ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();});
114:   ctx.restore();
115: 
116:   // ship (enhanced graphic)
117:   // draw ship with gradient body and a glowing thruster
118:   const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
119:   shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
120:   shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
121:   ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
122:   ctx.beginPath();
123:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h/2);
124:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w * 0.8, ship.y);
125:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w * 0.8, ship.y + ship.h);
126:   ctx.closePath();
127:   ctx.fill();
128:   // thruster flame with flicker
129:   ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
130:   ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 + Math.random()*0.3;
131:   ctx.beginPath();
132:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w * 0.8, ship.y + ship.h * 0.3);
133:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h/2);
134:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w * 0.8, ship.y + ship.h * 0.7);
135:   ctx.closePath();
136:   ctx.fill();
137:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
138: 
139:   // debris with rotation and gradient shading
140:   debris.forEach(d=>{
141:     const angle = Math.atan2(d.vy, d.vx);
142:     ctx.save();
143:     ctx.translate(d.x + d.w/2, d.y + d.h/2);
144:     ctx.rotate(angle);
145:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-d.w/2, -d.h/2, d.w/2, d.h/2);
146:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#f88');
147:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
148:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
149:     ctx.fillRect(-d.w/2, -d.h/2, d.w, d.h);
150:     ctx.restore();
151:   });
152: 
153:   // HUD
154:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
155:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
156:   ctx.fillText('Distance: '+Math.floor(distance),10,20);
157:   if(gameOver){
158:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
159:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
161:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
162:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
163:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2-20);
164:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
165:     ctx.fillText('Travelled: '+Math.floor(distance)+' units', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2+20);
166:   }
167: }
168: 
169: 
170: function loop(){
171:   if(!gameOver){
172:     update();
173:     draw();
174:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175:   } else {
176:     draw(); // final frame with overlay
177:   }
178: }
179: 
180: // start
181: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
